purpose: Experiment E-RLT-0094 in the relativity arena: isotropy of a covering vacuum, pass (the transport half against its prediction): no orientation of the coset-union store is kept by a group forcing the husk shear (every forcing subgroup of W(F4) generated by at most three elements contains one normal subgroup of order 288, and 0 of its 16,384 lift pairs keep an orientation; the two- and three-line covering patterns have 0 shear-forcing subgroups inside their orientable sets), because a symmetry fixing two stored lines of one frame must act on both by the same charge sign; yet the exact periodic husk transport of the oriented union (72 kept) reads charge 3.99, trace 4.14, sound 4.04 and shear 2.03, with the physical and staggered invariants uncoupled to 3e-12: the store's group is sufficient for isotropy, not necessary.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
